title: Predetermined balanced controller-design sensitivity protocol
status: Protocol saved before any design-sensitivity simulations
scope: Exploratory follow-up to the retained benchmark; no original controller replacement, global optimisation or physical validation.
tuning: Cstar=exp(j*(-180+PM)*pi/180)/P(j*wc). PI: Kp=Re(Cstar), Ki=-wc*Im(Cstar). PIDF: Tf=1/(N*wc), Ki=wc*Kp; solve real and imaginary equations for Kp,Kd.
eligibility: Retain every candidate in design_register.csv. Exclude nonfinite or nonpositive required gains. Independently check nominal augmented-state stability and all unity-gain crossings; target match tolerances 1e-7 relative frequency and 1e-6 degree. A valid matched comparison requires both designs eligible and their actual governing PM equal the common target. No alternative gains replace exclusions.
plantCases: All43 existing cases: nominal,32 corners and10 one-parameter endpoints. Fixed controller gains across plants. All positive-gain candidates are evaluated; unstable cases are explicit failures.

timeDomain.method: Augmented-state eigenmode response, same original sample times; recovery measured after load step through endpoint. IAE over29s. No output time series are retained for every candidate.

frequencyMetrics: Complete polynomial crossing inventory; compare nominal inventories with MATLAB allmargin, record numerical disagreement. Ms=max|1/(1+L)| via getPeakGain. Noise is |C/(1+PC)| at100rad/s for secondary measurement injection only.
comparisons: All feasible matched pairs; report counts, medians and ranges with equal design/case weights. Report infeasible and unpaired settings separately. No inferential p-values or probability interpretation.
qualityChecks: Cross-check the two retained controllers against saved nominal and all43 metrics; spot-check modal states against lsim; verify loop point and polynomial crossing residuals. Inspect any margin classification changes caused by exact crossing refinement. Check modal tail bounds at original endpoint.
interpretationLimits: The grid is deliberately finite and exploratory. Its outcome is conditional on gains, tuning closure, targets, model and load. Ms and one-frequency noise gain do not constitute hardware noise validation.
